# Echohearts path-specific Copilot instructions

Repository role: **ECOKIN_SUPPORT**

Own Eco-Kin support/archive/specialized content. Preserve the 125-ID Permanent Dex authority; prototypes/forms/historical names never auto-promote.

## Required behavior
- Follow `.github/copilot-instructions.md` first.
- Inspect current implementation and tests before generating replacements.
- Search the seven Echohearts repositories before duplicating a system.
- Preserve Rebearth canon, Eco-Kin taxonomy, the 125-ID Permanent Dex, Vibrance/Density/Harmony/Purity, Anima-Link, Huma-Link, and A.E.G.I.S.
- Keep executable gameplay in the BUILD repository unless this repository explicitly owns that runtime code.
- Fix root causes with focused patches; do not mass-rewrite working code without evidence.
- Add/update validation with code changes.
- Do not copy protected franchise code, assets, names, or story identity.
- Do not claim VERIFIED unless the relevant build/test/runtime evidence exists.
